bias.zh: 偏多 · 重回 $537 上方

read.en: Microsoft rose 1.1% on Oct 15 to $539.44 after trading between $531.22 and $541.13. It moved back just above its 5-day average ($538.6) and stays above the 10-day ($531.7), 30-day ($511.4), 100-day ($454.3) and 200-day ($435.0), all rising. MACD has been above its signal since Oct 1 and is above zero, but the histogram is narrowing, Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Aug 28 ($530.7), and RSI is 65.
read.zh: 微软 10月15日上涨 1.1%，收于 $539.44，当日区间 $531.22–541.13。股价重回 5 日均线（$538.6）略上方，并保持在均上行的 10 日（$531.7）、30 日（$511.4）、100 日（$454.3）和 200 日均线（$435.0）上方。MACD 自 10月1日起位于信号线上方并在零轴之上，但柱状图收窄，抛物线 SAR 自 8月28日起看多（$530.7），RSI 为 65。

read.en: The close reclaimed $537 (Oct 9 high), which turns back into support. Resistance is $541–543 (Oct 12 and 15 highs), then $551 (Oct 13 high) and the $553–555 record zone from October 2025. Support is $537, then $530.7–531.7 (SAR, 10-day average; day's low $531.2) and $511 (30-day). A close below $530.7 would flip the SAR bearish; a close above $555 would be a new record.
read.zh: 收盘收复 $537（10月9日高点），该位置重新转为支撑。阻力为 $541–543（10月12日及 15日高点），其次 $551（10月13日高点）和 2025年10月的 $553–555 纪录区域。支撑为 $537，其次 $530.7–531.7（SAR、10 日均线；当日低点 $531.2）和 $511（30 日均线）。若收盘跌破 $530.7，SAR 将转为看空；收盘站上 $555 则创纪录新高。

s.zh: 10月9日高点，重新成为支撑；5日均线 $538.6
